name: nexus-android
description: Your Android phone for Antigravity over plain ADB: see the screen, tap, type, open apps, read SMS and notifications, move files. No root, no phone app.
suggestedPrompts: Look at my phone screen and tell me which app is open.
Open the Settings app on my phone and turn on Do Not Disturb.
Read my latest SMS conversations and draft a reply to the most recent one without sending it.
